The '''Fondor system''' contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], homeworld of the [[Fondorian]]s, its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nallastia]], [[Thanut]], and the [[Fondor (star)|cognominal star]]—which, as one of the brightest bodies in the starscape, made the system easy to locate without sensors.<ref name="Adventures 3" /> It was in the [[Freeworlds Territory]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Fondor system was the theater of a [[Operation Midnight Freedom|battle]] concluded with a Republic victory.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=space|Fondor Escort}}</ref>
